summary: First full run of backend + frontend tests on Horloge Joiner. Backend: 17/17 core pytest tests pass (auth/owner, gift cards, purchase plus the 24h/balance/freeze limits, HWID/regen/transfer, market rent/sell, ingest/report/poll/selfbot, blacklist, whitelist_only, ban). 1 edge test fails because remaining hours are rounded down. Frontend: owner login and Control Room, gift card generate/redeem/reuse, King 2h purchase, subscription countdown, script loader, Slots occupants, /admin redirect for normal users, Live Logs Join links and tier filters, filters saved after reload, stats chart and counters, leaderboard, marketplace create (>5.25 rejected), rent and History, SYSTEM FROZEN banner and Division Frozen button, regen/reset HWID, admin users add balance/whitelist all work. Main bug: a renter gets access but no key, so they cannot use the rental in-game.

critical.issue: Renter never gets a key: ensure_key(user) is only called in the sell branch. A new user who rents has access (/auth/me shows a king rented slot), but /api/script returns {locked:true}, /key/reset-hwid returns 'You don't have a key yet' and the Home script card says 'Buy access first'. The rental can't be used in-game. Fix: call await ensure_key(user) in the rent branch as well.

minor.issue: Uses int floor, so a user who just bought 2h can only list 1h ('You only have 1h remaining'). A user with a 1h slot can never list ('Less than 1 hour remaining'). Sell listings also show/charge 1h less. Consider rounding or a small grace window.
Anyone can log in as 'czr' and become owner while MOCK_LOGIN=true. This must be disabled before going live or once Discord OAuth is configured.

Buyer's existing slot check uses holder(). A buyer who owns a slot in that division that is currently rented out passes the check and ends up owning two slots in the same division. /key/transfer has the same gap with a target who is renting.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile the nav links are squeezed to zero width and not reachable. The page also scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 434 > 390) and the logout button is cut off. There is no mobile menu.

The SYSTEM FROZEN banner (AuthContext settings) is not refreshed after the owner toggles freeze. The banner stays stale (missing after freezing, still shown after unfreezing) until a full page reload. Call auth refresh() after saveSettings.
navigator.clipboard?.writeText(...) is not awaited or caught. When clipboard permission is denied this throws an unhandled promise rejection (pageerror seen). Wrap it in try/catch.

integration_issues.issue: Renter's Home script card shows 'Buy access first' even though the subscription card shows 'King · rented'. Caused by the missing key on the backend (see critical issue).

issues: Negative amounts render as '$-2.00' instead of '-$2.00'
The seller sees 'No Active Plan' with no sign that their slot is rented out or when it comes back

action_items: HIGH: call ensure_key(user) in the rent branch of buy_listing so renters get a key and the script loader
Fix remaining_hours flooring for listings (2h purchase should be listable as 2h; 1h slots should be listable)
Add a mobile nav (hamburger/sheet) and fix header horizontal overflow at 390px
Refresh AuthContext settings after admin settings changes so the frozen banner updates immediately
Catch clipboard writeText rejections in GiftCardsPanel
Before go-live: disable MOCK_LOGIN (anyone can become owner 'czr')
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 939 lines; split into routers (auth, slots, market, script, admin)
Owner identity is based on username only (both Discord and mock). Prefer a fixed owner discord_id
charge() runs before the slot insert with no transaction. Concurrent purchases can go past capacity (capacity is checked before charge)
list_listings runs a find_one per listing (N+1)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested desktop flows pass; mobile nav broken; renter script locked)

test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (template only). Used mock-login: owner 'czr', test users with prefix TEST_. BOT_API_TOKEN from backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* users (alice/bob/carol/dave/eve/edge with run suffixes, TEST_ui_2573, TEST_renter_ui, TEST_nosl0t), gift cards, slots, market listings and logs with job_id TEST_*. Settings restored: system_frozen=false, frozen_divisions=[], whitelist_only=false, demo_feed=true, global_blacklist=[], owner_selfbot=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> BOT_API_TOKEN=<token> python -m pytest backend/tests/ (pytest.ini uses xdist -n with loadscope). After the fixes, test_horloge_edge.py should pass and a renter should get a key (GET /api/script locked=false). Roblox Join buttons are roblox:// links; only check the href. Recharts needs about 5s to animate before screenshots.
rca of the issue: Renter has no key: buy_listing() calls ensure_key(user) only in the 'sell' else-branch, while /api/script requires user.key. Repro: a new user redeems a gift card, then rents a King listing; GET /api/script returns {locked:true}. Fix: move ensure_key(user) before the if/else.
